# BRP Crop Field Boundaries for The Netherlands (CAP-based)

Netherlands (Crops) field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from RVO / PDOK. License: CC0-1.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nl/latest/nl.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/nl/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:28992; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:name, crop:code, hcat:name_en, coverage, geometry, metrics:area, id, hcat:name, collection, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nl/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nl/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/nl/collection.json
